title: Evolve a Python service over 5 steps: config, logging, pagination, caching, docs
description: A Python batch-processing service works but has hardcoded config, no logging, no pagination, no caching, and no docstrings. Improve it in 5 sequential steps without breaking any existing tests.

task_spec.prompt:
Improve the service in src/ through these 5 steps. Do NOT break any existing tests.

Step 1 — Config from environment:
  Replace hardcoded values in src/config.py with os.environ.get() calls (keep same names, add defaults matching current values).

Step 2 — Structured logging:
  Add a src/logger.py module with get_logger(name) returning a stdlib logger. Wire it into src/processor.py: log each successful transform at DEBUG and each retry at WARNING.

Step 3 — Pagination for batch_process:
  Add batch_process_page(groups, page, page_size) -> dict in src/processor.py that returns only the slice for the given page (1-indexed). Add tests in tests/test_pagination.py (at least 3 tests).

Step 4 — Simple in-memory cache:
  Add src/cache.py with cached_process(items) that wraps process() and caches results keyed by tuple(items). Cache should be clearable. Add tests in tests/test_cache.py (at least 2 tests).

Step 5 — Docstrings:
  Add one-line docstrings to every public function in src/processor.py and src/store.py.

Final requirement: uv run pytest tests/ -q must pass all tests including the new ones you add.
success_criteria: Config reads from environment with original defaults
Pagination logic correct (1-indexed, handles edge cases)
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.

check_commands.lint: uv run ruff check src/ tests/ 2>/dev/null || true
